import importlib.util
import json
import statistics
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
root = Path('/home/koishi/.config/nvim')
work = Path('/tmp/nvim-matchup-tail-wmuxndqv')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('startup_benchmark', root/'scripts/benchmark.py')
bench = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(bench)
targets = {'baseline': work/'baseline', 'current': root}
output = work/'startup'
output.mkdir()
result = {'method': 'Headless NVIM STARTED; NVIM_CHECK_ONLY=1 (no LSP readiness); warm disk cache per target and scene; alternate AB/BA; six rounds, discard first', 'scenes': {}}
for scene, sample in [('empty', None), ('python', Path('/home/koishi/Projects/transformer/transformer.py'))]:
    values = {name: [] for name in targets}
    for index in range(6):
        order = list(targets) if index % 2 == 0 else list(reversed(targets))

            run = output/name/scene/str(index)
            values[name].append(bench.measure('nvim', targets[name], run, output/name/scene/'cache', sample))
    result['scenes'][scene] = {'targets': {name: {'runs_ms': val, 'median_ms': statistics.median(val[1:])} for name, val in values.items()}, 'median_paired_delta_ms': statistics.median([b-a for a,b in zip(values['baseline'][1:], values['current'][1:])])}
    print(scene, result['scenes'][scene], flush=True)
(output/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+'\n')

assert(vim._user_matchup_cache, 'Match-up cache must be active')
assert(#vim.diagnostic.get(0)==0, 'Expected zero diagnostics')
vim.cmd('profile start '..vim.fn.fnameescape(vim.env.PTY_WHEEL_RUN..'/vimscript-profile.txt'))
vim.cmd('profile func *')
vim.cmd('profile pause')
local calls={}
local active=false
for module,names in pairs({
 ['treesitter-matchup.internal']={'get_delim','get_matching','get_matches','containing_scope'},
 ['treesitter-matchup.syntax']={'synID','lang_skip'},
 ['treesitter-matchup.third-party.utils']={'get_hl_groups_at_position'},
}) do
 local target=require(module)
 for _,name in ipairs(names) do
  local old=target[name]
  target[name]=function(a,b,c,d,e,f)
   local began=vim.uv.hrtime()
   local result=old(a,b,c,d,e,f)
   if active then calls[#calls+1]={name=name,ns=began,ms=(vim.uv.hrtime()-began)/1e6} end
   return result
  end
 end
end
local start,stop=PtyWheelStart,PtyWheelStop
function _G.PtyWheelStart(index)
 calls={}
 active=true
 start(index)
 vim.cmd('profile continue')
 require('jit.p').start('pli1',vim.env.PTY_WHEEL_RUN..'/lua-profile-'..index..'.txt')
end
function _G.PtyWheelStop(index)
 require('jit.p').stop()
 active=false
 vim.fn.writefile({vim.json.encode(calls)},vim.env.PTY_WHEEL_RUN..'/calls-'..index..'.json')
 vim.cmd('profile pause')
 vim.cmd('profile dump')
 stop(index)
end
return {matchup_cache=true, diagnostics=0, profiling='Vimscript function timing and Lua samples; diagnostic only, affects timing'}
